# Bundles

Every key of a campaign bundle's `manifest.json`, from `spec/bundle-manifest.json`. A dotted key sits inside the key before the dot, and an upper-case part such as `FIELD` stands for a name you choose.

manifest.json at the root of a campaign bundle produced by `gtme freeze --bundle` (SPEC.md §8, ADR-029). A bundle is self-contained (run resolves nothing outside it except credentials), diffable (text files, stable ordering), and portable (contracts travel; membership and cache stay with the ledger). DRAFT: authored in the ADR-022..029 reconciliation pass ahead of the build; the freeze/run/simulate acceptance criteria will harden it.

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle_format_version` | integer | yes | Format version of the bundle layout itself. |
| `name` | string | yes | The frozen pipeline's name. |
| `source_run_id` | string | yes | The run whose stored config snapshot this bundle was reconstructed from. |
| `created_at` | string | yes | RFC3339 timestamp of the freeze. |
| `gtm_version` | string | no | Version of the gtme binary that produced the bundle (informational). |
| `contents` | map of string matching `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | yes | Every file in the bundle except this manifest, keyed by bundle-relative path, valued by its sha256 hex digest. Stable (sorted-path) ordering when serialized. |

## Example

From `bundles/email-waterfall/manifest.json`, a pattern bundle frozen from a run:

```json

  "name": "email-waterfall",
  "source_run_id": "01M2EPQSC6EBJBW6FSCMB5HQ2W",
  "created_at": "2026-09-14T00:58:09.694Z",
  "gtm_version": "v0.5.2-0.20260914003239-614243ceabdb+dirty",
  "contents": {
```
